body: MAINLINE-017 filed. I re-optimised thickness and core depth at every step for the three best P2 points from 014 and the best P3 point from 011. 014b, 011b and 013 had not filed and are named as unused. On all three P2 leaders the cheapest direction is face density alone: CNT-yarn by 1.459123 to 959.5 kg/m3, Be S-200F by 1.637323, graphene by 1.654709. Those faces are PROJECTION; the lightest QUESTIONABLE face today is T700 at 1550 kg/m3. The one direction whose required value exists in sourced form is the CNT wrinkling coefficient, 1.818487 to 0.600 against a theoretical 0.82. Core Gc alone is a trap: past Vc 2 the handbook returns the point to kd 0.20 and the least factor falls. P3 SiC is already 2.848 on 011's scored modes, conditional on the two absent modes; T700 tubes need only 1.307 in density or 1.308 in strength. Directions are ranked by gap in the card. QUESTIONABLE, not a certification. The brief says stop and file, so no next job is started.
